detail.longDescription: Ever since AI has come, I've got worse at managing project tasks / goals. When you develop so fast now, things start lacking behind. For that reason I looked into creating a good set of skills I can use in any agent that support skills. The result is billet-skills which you can find at https://github.com/Skytrias/billet-skills Tasks are Markdown files with JSON frontmatter that live in docs/tasks/: --- { "id": 7, "title": "Add dark mode", "status": "ready", ... } --- ## Outcome The app follows the system's light or dark setting. This allows me to create a bunch of tasks upfront and work on things more easily or in parallel. Billet comes in two parts: 1. billet-skills, the skills: https://github.com/Skytrias/billet-skills 2. Billet, the viewer https://mktwsk.xyz/billet Billet has a few ways of looking at the tasks in your project: - List Mode - Kanban Mode - Plan Mode Multiple Projects can be seen in the Home Dashboard and also a simple Timeline. You can change the skills to whatever you like as long as it conforms to the format. Other than that thats pretty much it. I've also got easy copy&paste support so it becomes easier saying "work on X and Y". Billet is free - Give it a try and have fun! Feedback is welcome :) Billet itself is closed-source though - as I have commercial projects that use the same UI core. --- For those interested in the tech: - Software Rendered UI, using Blend2D - Custom immediate mode UI - Custom platform layer - Made in Odin
